title: Density of States of Gravitationally Active Grid Modes: Derivation of Deff (ρ) and Completion of the Γ(ρ) Bridge
description: Derives the effective density of states Deff(ρ) for gravitationally active grid modes from microphysical boundary-mode activation on a finite lattice. The derivation yields Deff(ρ) ∝ √(ρ/ρcrit) with ρcrit = a0/(GN lg), leading to a microphysically fixed entropy-production bridge Γ(ρ) = Γ0 y/(1+y) with y = √(ρ/ρcrit), thereby upgrading the Γ(ρ) status to Scenario B+ and eliminating free functional degrees of freedom.
author: Morten Magnusson

activation_condition.description: Grid node activation criterion: local gravitational energy across a node exceeds the node tension threshold.

sigma_equals_a0.description: Identification of node tension with the MOND scale from the gradient-coupled grid action.

rho_crit.description: Critical density emerging from microphysics; sets the activation scale for shortest-wavelength grid modes.

boundary_mode_counting.description: Maximum active standing-wave mode in a potential well of size r; follows from requiring mode energy to exceed the activation threshold.

deff_scaling.description: Effective density of active grid modes grows as the square root of density due to boundary-mode activation.

gamma_bridge.description: Microphysically determined entropy-production bridge with correct low-ρ rise and high-ρ saturation; no free functional form.

key_results.main_finding: Boundary-mode activation on a finite gravitational well yields Deff(ρ) ∝ √(ρ/ρcrit) with ρcrit = a0/(GN lg), implying Γ(ρ) = Γ0 √(ρ/ρcrit)/(1+√(ρ/ρcrit)) and upgrading the bridge to Scenario B+.

sealed_predictions.statement: The entropy-production function follows Γ(ρ) = Γ0 y/(1+y) with y = √(ρ/ρcrit) over cosmologically relevant densities, with a fixed ρcrit = a0/(G_N l_g) and no additional shape parameters.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Reconstruction of Γ(ρ) from cosmological background and growth data (e.g., EFC fits to H(z), structure growth, lensing) showing a shape inconsistent with the √ρ saturation (deviations >20% across ρ range).

sealed_predictions.statement: The low-density scaling of the effective density of states is Deff(ρ) ∝ √ρ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: First-principles simulations of grid-lattice microdynamics or indirect reconstruction of active-mode counts versus ρ demonstrating a different low-ρ power-law index.

sealed_predictions.statement: At ρ = ρcrit the shortest-wavelength mode (λ = l_g) transitions to activation, providing the saturation pivot for Γ(ρ).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Any consistent EFC cosmology inference requiring a saturation pivot density that is not constant or not equal to a0/(G_N l_g), or exhibits significant redshift evolution.

kill_criteria: KC1: A robust observational reconstruction of Γ(ρ) (from background expansion and growth) that rules out the √ρ saturation form Γ(ρ) = Γ0 y/(1+y), y = √(ρ/ρcrit), by >20% across the relevant density range.
KC2: Evidence that ρcrit is not equal to a0/(G_N l_g) or that ρcrit varies with redshift or environment beyond a few percent, contradicting the microphysical derivation.
KC3: First-principles simulations of the grid microphysics demonstrating Deff(ρ) scales with a power of ρ different from 1/2 at low densities.
KC4: Empirical requirements for additional free shape parameters in Γ(ρ) (beyond the overall amplitude Γ0) to fit data, contradicting the 'no free function' claim of the microphysical bridge.
key_result: D_eff(ρ) ∝ √(ρ/ρ_crit) from boundary-mode mechanism; Γ(ρ) = Γ₀√(ρ/ρ_crit)/(1+√(ρ/ρ_crit)) — Scenario B+
